name: Cali Blaze Tarantula Preroll | Watermelon
description:
Fresh, juicy watermelon with a sweet finish. This sativa delivers clean, refreshing flavor with balanced effects that hit smooth and easy. Perfect for a warm day or anytime you want a light, fruity smoke.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
